resources.string: Pair devices on the same Wi-Fi to send directly while Sliploom is open.
Trusted devices are unavailable. Connect to Wi-Fi and keep Sliploom open.
On the other device, open Trusted devices and tap Scan QR.
Sliploom trusted device pairing QR code
Enter the SEAM5 pairing code shown on the other device. Keep the code private.
Point the camera at the pairing QR in Trusted devices.
This isn’t a SEAM5 pairing code.
Compare this verification code with the one shown on %1$s. Confirm only if they match.
Pairing allows this device to send files that Sliploom saves automatically while it’s open. You can remove this permission by forgetting the device.
Pairing didn’t complete here. If this device appears on the other device, forget it there before trying again.
Pairing was interrupted. Check Trusted devices on both devices before trying again.
Pairing code expired. Start a new pairing to try again.
Forget %1$s? It can no longer send files to this device without a new invitation.
Could not forget this device. Try again.
Could not connect to the trusted device. Make sure Sliploom is open there and both devices are on the same Wi-Fi.
File saved. Open Receive history to view it.
